entities.name: Jiří Kovář
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Kovář is a Czech-born Italian volleyball player, a member of Italy men's national volleyball team and Turkish club Galatasaray. He was silver medalist of the European Championship 2013, bronze medalist of the World League 2014, and triple Italian Champion.
